[[File:Rikuo POKÉTOON.png|thumb|250px|Rikuo]] '''Rikuo''' (Japanese: '''リクオ''' ''Rikuo'') is a character who appeared in ''[[PT04|Wait for Me, Magikarp!]]'', the fourth episode of the [[POKÉTOON]] animated shorts. He likes to play a flute, the sound of which caught the attention of a {{p|Magikarp}}, which he ended up befriending and leaving at a [[Pokémon Nursery]]. When he later returned, Magikarp evolved into {{p|Gyarados}}. ==Pokémon== ===Befriended=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Rikuo |pkmn=Gyarados |stage1=Magikarp |type1=Water |type2=Flying |img=PT04.png |cap=Rikuo's Magikarp |img2=Gyarados POKÉTOON.png |epnum=PT04 |epname=Wait for Me, Magikarp! |desc=Rikuo befriended {{p|Magikarp}} with the melody from his flute. It eventually [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{p|Gyarados}}.
